q1: SELECT beer.name, min_price, bar FROM beer LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT beer, MIN(price) AS min_price FROM serves GROUP BY beer) AS t ON beer.name = t.beer LEFT OUTER JOIN serves ON beer.name = serves.beer AND min_price = serves.price
q2: SELECT Beer.name AS beer, MIN(Serves.price) AS price, Bar.name AS bar FROM Beer LEFT JOIN Serves ON Beer.name = Serves.beer LEFT JOIN Bar ON Serves.bar = Bar.name GROUP BY Beer.name, Bar.name HAVING NOT MIN(Serves.price) IS NULL UNION SELECT Beer.name, NULL AS price, NULL AS bar FROM Beer WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Serves WHERE Serves.beer = Beer.name) ORDER BY beer, price, bar
